summary: Carded from Fabio's ask: one supplied image in, a character sheet out, with the front full body HEADLESS. Not new on the board but never a card - it was candidate workflow 4 in MPI-348 s8, whose own working mode says surfaced ideas get their own card. Carries the Higgsfield HELL GRIND sheet spec (3 panels, headless front body, large 3/4 portrait, boring flat grey with no grain baked in, mandatory pupil catch-light, pick believable over beautiful) and flags that it CONFLICTS with Fabio's own best-performing layout from past tests (side + front profile + full body) - settle at the bench. Names the real risk: their sheets came from a PROMPT in a hosted creative model, ours must hold identity onto a back view from one photo, and MPI-348 s7 already records Qwen-Edit as weak on single-image instruction edits. Headless panel specced as a SAM3 mask + empty-prompt klein inpaint, not a prompt, which also honours their never-run-an-image-through-a-model-twice rule. Id claimed with exclusive mkdir.

Re-scoped by Fabio. The MPI-348 s8.4 layout (side + front profile + full body) is a LORA-TRAINING sheet - a different consumer - so the two layouts are NOT a conflict to settle; layout becomes a flow option keyed to purpose, and this card owns the VIDEO-REFERENCE layout only. Input is now TWO paths: attributes-only (what the character is, wardrobe, scars, age, hair colour, eye colour) restructured into the sheet prompt, and a reference photo. The attributes path is the LOW-RISK one and ships first - it is exactly what Higgsfield did (prompt to sheet in a hosted model) and has no identity-projection problem; the photo path keeps the unproven back-view step. Added: with structured fields a slot template needs no LLM, so Cubric Prompt earns its place only on free prose or per-model shaping. Recorded that their 'never write an age' rule does NOT transfer - that is a hosted content filter and Vision runs local models.

Two corrections from Fabio. (1) The LoRA-training sheet is OUT OF SCOPE, not a layout option - it is ~20 images and a whole different beast, addressed when that flow is addressed; MPI-504 owns the video-reference 3-panel sheet only. (2) The flow needs TWO MODELS, chosen per path at the bench - an EDIT model for the reference path, and for the attributes path whichever t2i model best obeys a prompt asking it to display the character in that layout. That second question is LAYOUT COMPLIANCE, not aesthetics, and has no answer on the board. Multiple models in one flow is the point of flows.

Re-scoped by Fabio to a SHIPPABLE v1: prompt-only, no image input. Krea2 t2i sheet from a proven prompt template, optional SAM3+Klein head removal on the small figure (default on), 8:5, 1k/2k (2k default), turbo off by default. In-graph enhancer recipe gets a character-only rewrite.
Ownership written to files.json: the card workspace plus the new raw flow graph candidate.

Re-scoped to a shippable v1 and retitled. Image input DROPPED to v2 (head-swap covers identity as a second pass), so the unproven back-view identity step leaves the card. Written this session with no GPU: plan.md (flow fields, the group-by-group strip of krea2_t2i_template.json, the SAM3+Klein head branch, five open bench calls) and prompts.md (the sheet template in four styles with the gendered words neutralised, the character-only enhancer system prompt for node 420, the removal prompt). Graph itself untouched - comfy_workflows/raw/ is user-owned.

Two decisions from Fabio. (1) GEAR POLICY settled: worn weapons/kit belong ON the sheet - the cowboy-movie sheets this layout comes from had none, and that cost separate item sheets plus unknown scale. Three tiers, all recipe text and NO new field: named gear always worn, at most two archetype-inevitable pieces when the user names none, none at all when the user rules it out in plain words. The third tier needs no UI because the LLM reads 'no weapons' as an instruction and the image prompt simply omits it - a negative never reaches Krea2, which is positive-phrasing-only. Hands stay open and empty; held objects remain banned. (2) HEAD PICKING solved by Fabio's face idea: a face exists only on the portrait and the FRONT body (the rear view has none), so detecting faces identifies the front panel with no classifier - retiring the left-half rectangle and keeping the rear view's hair reference. Verified against the engine source: SAM3_Detect sorts by CONFIDENCE not size (nodes_sam3.py:223 argsort on scores), so 'face number two' is a confidence race; sort by area with ImpactSEGSOrderedFilter instead. face_yolov8n.pt is already a shipped dep and emits SEGS directly. Also corrected the strip list: keep Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora, and the accelerator LoRA survives Detailer/Upscale deletion because Generation carries its own (440).

Enhancer regression run on bench 8188, no generation. Drafted recipe failed (in-prompt example returned verbatim for 2 of 4 inputs); revised to v3 over three arms. Positive-phrasing unfixable in the prompt on this 4B, closed with two RegexReplace scrub nodes verified offline. use_default_template measured inert.

flow_character_sheet.json created by stripping the seven groups from krea2_t2i_template.json: 218->82 nodes, 276->98 links, 10->3 groups, per-group counts asserted against plan.md before writing. Collapse worklist audited into plan.md.

Fabio cut the gear policy's THIRD TIER (user rules gear out -> sheet wears none). The regression disproved it: v1 gave 'a gunslinger, no weapons' a gunbelt outright, and v3 only read clean because the model NAMED the absences and the scrub deleted the naming - phrasing luck, not compliance. Recipe rule 5 deleted and rules renumbered; recipe now writes the character only. Gear exclusion becomes the user's job via a PROMPT REVIEW step, which is not new architecture: it is the shipped Describe Image shape (op declares outputKind text, graph carries the Output_prompt PreviewAny - node 242 already exists here, generationService branches on outputKind before the empty-media check, describeAction emits workspace:inject-prompts so the text lands in the prompt box editable). Optional button, not the default path; wired in the /mpi-add-flow pass. The two RegexReplace scrub nodes STAY - negation is not weapons-specific ('no facial hair', 'no tattoos') and reaches Krea2 the same way. Rejected: a StringContains-triggered weapon-clause regex, an open-ended wordlist that would also delete a wanted satchel. Regression input 4 demoted from gate to watch: it must still prove the user's words 'no weapons' never survive into the output.

STRIP LIST RETIRED - it deletes load-bearing nodes and fails silently. Traced in the file: the Edit group BUILDS the shared conditioning (51/282 CLIPTextEncode off Get_positive/negative text, 294/302 MpiIfElse plain-vs-grounded, 143/290 ToBasicPipe High/Balanced, 621 MpiIfElse on Get_turbo -> 253 Set_Models), and 77 FromBasicPipe inside the KEPT Generation group reads Get_Models - so deleting Edit costs every sampler its positive, negative and vae. The Images group holds 75 Input_Width / 74 Input_Height -> 458 Set_W / 459 Set_H -> 560 EmptyLatentImage, so deleting it costs the fixed 8:5 resolution. SetNode/GetNode link by NAME, so a link-integrity check passes on a decapitated graph - which is why the earlier 'all links resolve: true' meant nothing. The 50-node intermediate was removed; krea2_t2i_template.json untouched throughout. FABIO'S CALL: he strips it in the bench editor (t2i only), and prompt enhancement becomes its own workflow flow_character_enhance.json - ~10 nodes, no UNET/VAE/sampler, the shipped image_descriptor.json shape. Consequences: the sheet graph drops the whole Prompt Enhancement group and node 241, Input_enhance_prompt disappears as a field (the button enhances, the box holds the result, the sheet takes it verbatim, so double-enhance is impossible), and Output_prompt is rewired to the ASSEMBLED sheet prompt so the MPI-242 record is what Krea2 actually saw. Keep-list and enhancer spec in plan.md. Also v4 recipe (rule 5 removed) confirmed on the bench: 70-82 words 4/4, no example leak, nothing held 4/4, scrub clean 4/4. Input 4 returned 'with a gunbelt slung low across his hips' - positively phrased, uncatchable by any scrub, which is the empirical proof that cutting tier 3 was correct.

Fabio exported two hand-built graphs; both verified offline, no generation. krea2_t2i_only.json (54 nodes) is CLEAN - 0 orphan Gets, 0 dangling required inputs, all links resolve, conditioning intact via FromBasicPipe<-Get_Models, resolution wired direct from Input_Width/Input_Height, Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora still at strength 1, both turbo switches live (621 picks the Balanced/High pipe, 619 picks the decode), four samplers 25/8/3/2, zero TextGenerate. Fixed on his explicit authorisation: node 665 title Input_height -> Input_Height (single token, 54 nodes/69 links unchanged) - the app canonical is capital H and the lowercase form appears nowhere in js/, so injection would have silently missed it. LoRA rack KEPT by Fabio as a feature: a user with a character LoRA loads it and describes only wardrobe/hair/face on top - LoRA carries identity, sheet carries layout. Needs no new machinery; flow_ltx_extend and flow_ltx_foley already ship the same six-slot rack and comfyController routes Input_Lora_N through its MPI-219 LoRA-object branch. qwen3vl_4b_prompt_enhancer.json (10 nodes) has the right skeleton and exact sampler params but THREE OPEN GAPS: its system prompt is still the OLD scene-writing recipe (node 420 never swapped, 2137 chars vs v4 3885, 28 v4 lines absent), both RegexReplace scrub nodes are missing, and Input_enhance_prompt defaults to false so as exported it returns the users raw text unchanged - delete that MpiIfElse rather than flipping it.

Patched qwen3vl_4b_prompt_enhancer.json directly, on Fabio's go, to avoid hand-transcribing a 3885-char prompt and two escaped regexes. (1) System prompt swapped from the OLD scene-writing recipe to v4, read out of prompts.md and confirmed byte-for-byte identical after the round trip (2137 -> 3885 chars). (2) Two RegexReplace nodes inserted between StringReplace and Output_prompt, shaped like the StringReplace already in the graph - three widget values only, so case_insensitive (true), multiline/dotall (false) and count (0) take their defaults, which are the wanted values; no RegexReplace existed anywhere in the repo to copy, so the shape was derived from /object_info. (3) The Input_enhance_prompt MpiIfElse was DELETED rather than flipped from false - the workflow only ever enhances and a toggle that can make it a passthrough is a footgun. Result: 11 nodes, 10 links, no dangling required inputs, all links resolve, ChatML branch untouched, chain is CLIPLoader -> TextGenerate -> StringReplace -> scrub-negation -> tidy -> Output_prompt. Both patterns survive the JSON round trip byte for byte and, applied AS STORED to the four real v4 outputs, give 61-71 words with no negation and no trailing stop 4/4. Still unproven: that Python re agrees with the offline JS check - needs one live run, not yet authorised.

Fabio: the Image Descriptor already drives this same 4B, so the enhancer must be UNIVERSAL with the recipe injected at run time. Done, and it needed retitles rather than new plumbing - _inject sprays into value/string and MPI-359's Title.widget form addresses one named widget. Inject keys: Input_System_Prompt (the recipe), Input_Positive (user text), Input_Scrub_Negation.regex_pattern and Input_Tidy.regex_pattern. The scrub patterns were made injectable too, deliberately: a universal workflow with a baked character-sheet scrub would silently mangle another flow's output, and a flow that wants none injects a pattern that cannot match ((?!x)x, verified live - the trailing full stop survives, proving the injected pattern replaced the baked one). Character-sheet values remain the baked defaults so it runs standalone at the bench. Also added MpiClearVram after TextGenerate, where image_descriptor.json puts it, since the 4B stays resident and a sheet generation usually follows. 12 nodes, 11 links, converts cleanly through scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs with _meta.title intact. LIVE PROOF, two arms, no image: defaults gave 61-71 words with no negation and no trailing stop on all four inputs, each matching the offline JS scrub prediction BYTE FOR BYTE (so Python re agrees with JS), with execution_cached covering only [7,9] so TextGenerate ran fresh; and an injected translator recipe returned French. Consequence for the docs: the recipe is now APP payload, not graph payload - prompts.md's opening claim was corrected. Open for /mpi-add-flow: whether the op should be a universal promptEnhance in the getUniversalWorkflow('imageDescribe') shape rather than sheet-specific.
